description: Built-in organ pack for breast Xenium cases with breast-specific cluster annotation defaults, public workflow template defaults, and expected artifact groups.
default_study_context: Human breast cancer Xenium case. Run breast-specific OpenAI-driven cluster annotation from graph-based differential expression evidence, then propagate the generated labels through structure discovery, H&E overlay, and AI spatial pathology review. Treat this as pathology decision support, not an autonomous diagnosis.
